title: The Coming of the Son of Man Like the Days of Noah
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner dives into the biblical account of the days of Noah, revealing a startling pattern of events that will repeat itself when Jesus returns. As Jesus prophesied in Matthew 24, the coming of the Son of Man will mirror the exact circumstances leading up to the flood, warning us to be ready for His unexpected return. Join Pastor Chris as he uncovers the six major occurrences in the days of Noah that will give us a front-row seat to the Rapture and the return of our Lord.
